QuestInfo.0: Ask the #bSorcerer#k in the Road to Oblivion about the Fog of Oblivion.
QuestInfo.1:
The Sorcerer said he will refine the Fog of Oblivion. Enter the Sorcerer's refinement chamber and help in his work. 

#e#bEnter the Sorcerer's refinement chamber

yes.0: Good. Refined Fog of Oblivion, coming up. To my refinement chamber.
yes.1: What are we going to do there? Oh, you'll find out. Go ahead, it's over there #bon the left#k.

no.0: You don't want to help me refine it? Don't expect your money to help you, if that's what you're thinking...

1.0: Ah, I've learned much from observing you.

yes.0: But, more than that, I've made the Oblivion Essence you wanted. Wait a moment, and I'll place it inside an orb for you.
